fields: h, intro, items [{t, d, hold, link}], core (optional centre word). Six steps fit best (three a side); any count works. Pointing at a step lights its node.
best_for: CapaRing shows a closed-loop procedure (a defect held, decided, repaired, corrected, checked and reported) as steps around one ring that the water runs once and closes, the hold step drawn as a closed valve.

items.d: Whoever finds it tags and segregates the item, or stops work, and raises an NCR.
Reject, rework or accept as is. Accepting as is, or an unapproved repair, needs your approval.

instances.h: Chemical sanitization, proven at every outlet

block.h: Chemical sanitization, proven at every outlet
block.intro: Sanitization is a design choice: the method suits the material. A specifier can accept chemical sanitization of a plastic loop written as a procedure, checked at every outlet.

items.d: Bypass or remove the parts the sanitant could harm, as the written procedure lists them.
Fill the tank and loop: [PP loop sanitization method], at [sanitant concentration].
Measure the sanitant at every outlet before the hold starts, so no branch is missed.

items.hold: the operator, at start and end
items.d: Hold for [contact time, hours], with the tank and loop out of use.
Flush the tank and loop with Purified Water, outlet by outlet.
Residual tested before use, at every outlet. The signed record goes to your quality unit.
